messages:
lee_support: Heads-up — customer (acct: acme-corp) opened a severity-high ticket: sudden answer-quality regression after our quant profile update. They say outputs omit an authentication step and hallucinate a support email. They rolled this to canary ~2026-03-15T10:00Z.

lee_support: Customer-provided example (anonymized):
User prompt: "Explain how to rotate service account keys and update OIDC config for SSO"
Expected (previous): includes step to update service principle mapping + confirm ID token issuer URL.
Observed (after quant_profile int8_v2): omitted issuer URL step and added a wrong email address in recommended contact.

lee_support: Request metadata they attached: model=redwood-xl-2, quant_profile=int8_v2, max_tokens=256, temperature=0.0, streaming=false. No API errors or auth failures reported — strictly behavioral change.

lee_support: Repro steps I ran quickly (local):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-xl-2","input":"Explain how to rotate service account keys and update OIDC config for SSO","quant_profile":"int8_v2","max_tokens":256,"temperature":0.0}'
```
Output matched customer's current behavior.

maria_ml: ack, looking into model-side changes. Was int8_v2 applied as a global rollout or per-customer canary?

lee_support: It was pushed to canary group yesterday for 15% traffic (config: rollout/quant-profile/int8_v2 -> canary). No infra changes. deploy-bot posted the rollout at 2026-03-15T09:58Z.

deploy-bot: [automated] rollout started: quant_profile=int8_v2 -> target=canary(15%) at 2026-03-15T09:58:12Z.

jamie_eng: I can reproduce locally. Quick diff on token probs shows layer 10 attention scale differences after quant. Small but accumulative. Example log snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T11:02:01Z] gold_token=\"issuer\" p=0.12 | int8_v1 p=0.11 | int8_v2 p=0.03
[2026-03-15T11:02:01Z] layer10_scale_hist: v1 mean=0.0034 v2 mean=0.0021 (clipped tails)
```
jamie_eng: Looks like more aggressive clipping/scale truncation in int8_v2 for some attention heads. That can change rare-token probabilities and reorder beam candidates.

maria_ml: Did you run the canary eval set (our regression harness) against int8_v2? Any metric delta?

jamie_eng: Running now — small run (500 prompts) shows exact-match drop 2.8% and factuality score (our QA eval) -6.4% vs int8_v1. Latency and token-cost improved slightly (~6%), but quality delta is non-trivial.

ravi_infra: No CPU/GPU errors in infra, memory normal. No abnormal throttles or retries in canary. API latency flat.

model_ops_bot: Canary telemetry snapshot -> quality_alert: threshold_exceeded. Canary group traffic: 15%. Regression window start 2026-03-15T10:05Z.

lee_support: Customer is pushing for a rollback and wants ETA. They flagged production impact for two support playbooks.

maria_ml: Priority: rollback canary to int8_v1 for affected model immediately, then run the full eval suite before any broader rollout. Jamie, can you produce a minimal reproducer and a short description of the quant op differences we saw? I'll prepare customer-facing note.

jamie_eng: Minimal repro attached inline: prompt + seeds + model args (same as lee's curl). Diff note: int8_v2 uses per-channel asymmetric clipping with a lower outlier budget; int8_v1 used per-tensor scaled clipping. The per-channel scheme reduces average MSE but introduces more variance for low-frequency tokens.

jamie_eng: I'll open a bug (OPS-4512) with logs and gradient-free quant stats. Plan: rollback canary, run 10k-sample eval, root-cause patch to relax clipping budget for attention layers, and re-run quantization calibration focusing on tail-token preservation.

ravi_infra: I can rollback canary config now. Rolling config back to int8_v1 for redwood-xl-2 canary. ETA ~5m.

deploy-bot: [automated] rollout update: quant_profile=int8_v1 -> target=canary(15%) at 2026-03-15T11:15:22Z.

jamie_eng: After rollback quick check: sampling the same prompt returns expected issuer token and no wrong email; initial QA checks look back to baseline. Will kick off regression harness (10k) and post results here.

maria_ml: Customer update draft: "we identified a quantization calibration change in a recent canary profile that altered rare-token probabilities. We have rolled the canary back to the prior profile and are running a comprehensive regression suite; we will follow up with results and a timeline for a fixed profile." Anyone object?

lee_support: sending that now, and offering priority support & a test endpoint for them to validate.

model_ops_bot: Regression harness queued (job id 99021). Expected runtime ~45m. Link: https://ci.internal/jobs/99021

jamie_eng: Harness results (final): exact-match delta -0.2% vs baseline (within noise). Factuality delta -0.5%. Looks like rollback recovered behavior. I captured quant stats and will attach to OPS-4512.

maria_ml: Next steps: 1) root cause doc and quant-recalibration PR that adjusts clipping budget on attention heads (assigned to jamie). 2) Add targeted evals for low-frequency factual tokens to our canary suite. 3) Change rollout policy: require 10k-sample regression pass + factuality threshold before any profile expands beyond 10%.

lee_support: Customer confirmed they see baseline behavior again and appreciated the quick rollback. They asked for a postmortem and prevented re-rollout without explicit CS/ML signoff.

jamie_eng: Creating PR and test plan. Will include synthetic prompts focusing on SSO/OIDC vocabulary and our factuality metric.

lee_support: Thanks all. Marking this resolved for now; keep OPS-4512 updated.

maria_ml: Adding follow-up: audit other models that got int8_v2 canary in past 48h and run smoke factuality checks.

lee_support: Noted. Closing loop with the customer and scheduling a short postmortem with CS/ML/OPS tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
